instrument: single BitMEX XBTUSD inverse perpetual; BTC collateral
objective: net BTC equity log growth, including commission/slippage/funding
algorithm: recurrent PPO plus clipped enumerated counterfactual policy gradient and Q regression
stage: A of three; isolates the credit-assignment horizon and the holding-time prior
stage_a_hypothesis: v5 collapsed because gamma*lambda gave a 2.9 h advantage window while a 12 bp round trip needs ~22 h in position to break even, so entering was negative in expectation everywhere the gradient could see
stage_a_success_test: median in-market holding spell within 12-48 h and state_action_mutual_information > 0 at update 400; validation return is NOT the stage A criterion
unchanged_from_v5: reward (100x net log BTC equity change)
fee 5 bp and slippage 1 bp per leg
exploration: trainable side-specific continuation bias initialized to 0.995 when flat and 0.9965 when holding; no forced holding time or market trading rule
initial_training_states: one-third untouched flat histories, otherwise 128-step persistent random-action prefix creates valid flat/long/short histories including costs; evaluation always starts flat
counterfactual: all three first actions on copied ledgers, then sampled current-policy continuation for 48 decisions and value bootstrap; no fake on-policy samples
diagnostics: state_action_mutual_information (zero exactly when the policy ignores the market), the same restricted to flat states (entry-direction dependence), and the mean and standard deviation of the switch probability across states
selection: one common budget across all seven seeds and three years; actual seven-member mixture evaluated; no automatic test or final retraining
base_ledger: frozen perpetual_v4 accounting and causal features
